thesis: Pre-open headlines for 2026-09-11 feature cautious anticipatory sentiment ahead of the August CPI inflation release ('Stock futures rise ahead of August CPI inflation report') alongside ongoing geopolitical and energy strain from Middle East conflicts and Strait of Hormuz disruptions carrying over from earlier sessions. Company-specific news items (HIVE AI cloud scaling, Morgan Stanley upgrade of Synopsys, Beam Therapeutics trial data, AT&T valuation chatter) are either idiosyncratic, promotional, or outside our 20-symbol universe, offering no clear high-conviction catalyst to alter our balanced allocation. Holding our 4-position book—core broad equity index VTI, fixed-income ballast BND, and technology/semiconductor growth sleeves NVDA and XLK—preserves proper diversification (cap 6), keeps all single-name positions well below the 35% cap (VTI ~28%, NVDA ~18%), and maintains our $35.00 cash reserve (~32% of equity, comfortably exceeding the 15% floor) ahead of the inflation data.
